value.rationale: A naturally motivated conditional geometric limit identifies the shape of extremely atypical samples, with nontrivial k-dimensional feasible polytope and asymptotic independent excesses. It resolves concrete endpoint coefficient and correlation-structure questions for a known difficult scalar law. No claim of universal k-asymptotics or closed volume evaluation.
